name: Runner Extras - Namespaced Dependency Dataitem
brief: Regression for issue #2419: a query dataitem naming a dependency table through a namespace `using` reaches the runner as the app-qualified symbol form '#<appid>#Item Ledger Entry', which the table resolver did not recognise, so the query got no metadata and every SetRange/Open on it NREd inside NavQuery.
description: The BC-language contract this exercises - a namespaced query joining a Base Application table through a `using` reads its joined row - is a plain BC-behaviour claim and belongs upstream in the al-language corpus (see the runner repo's bc-behavior-tests-go-upstream.md); the shape was measured green on a real BC 28.4 service tier before the issue was filed. This suite is the runner-repo-local stopgap so this repo's own CI gates the fix now; once the corpus test lands and the pin moves it may be retired. Needs the Base Application floor because the joined table is Item Ledger Entry.
